title: Taz’s long pursuit of Sabu
summary: Taz’s bitterness after injury fuels a new identity and a prolonged challenge to Sabu. The confrontation becomes a centerpiece of ECW’s first pay-per-view, with Bill Alfonso’s loyalty central to the aftermath.

chapters.title: Taz sides with Alfonso
chapters.result: Taz helps Alfonso defeat Tod Gordon and denounces the fans.
chapters.context: His grievance over feeling abandoned during injury establishes the colder, confrontational character.

chapters.title: Taz wins, but loses his manager
chapters.result: Taz submits Sabu; Alfonso then sides with Sabu and Van Dam.
chapters.context: Victory resolves the long challenge while the post-match betrayal creates a new conflict.
